name: amerp
description: Local-first Electron ERP for ISO9001-oriented jobshops.
author: Audacity Micro

scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:artifacts: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.cjs --publish never
